There are three (currently), HyperSpin Database XML Files here on the drive, these were requested of me to post back on /r/HyperSpin. All are just different ways that I am splicing up MAME on my Main Menu (so I don't have to explain favorites/genres to people all the time). These are from MAME .153, so any newly compatible games you want to add, you will need to do so on your own (Raiden II, new versions of Golden Tee).

In no particular order:

  • MAME.xml - This contains All Games, minus spinner games, minus mahjong games, minus 'billiard/darts' games, and minus adult games (adult as in nudity, I don't care about violent games, they stayed in).
  • Arcade Classics.xml - Contains only more popular mainstream games. So I can tell guests to go there, unless they want something real specific.
  • 3 4 player arcade.xml - Contains only games that allow 3 or 4 players (excluding spinners, dual joys - things that cannot be played by 3/4 people on a 4 joystick CP).

A note about 3/4 Player, some of the games have to be configured in Dip Switch Settings, so don't forget to do that!

you have to go and edit the MAME.AHK module's MSystem line to use HyperLaunch/RocketLauncher the new "3 4 player arcade" and "Arcade Classics", very simple step, but critical. Original Line example, vs Modified line below it:

MSystem = "AAE","Cave","LaserDisc","MAME","Nintendo Arcade Systems","Sega Model 1","Sega ST-V","SNK Neo Geo","SNK Neo Geo AES"

MSystem = "AAE","Cave","LaserDisc","MAME","Nintendo Arcade Systems","Sega Model 1","Sega ST-V","SNK Neo Geo","SNK Neo Geo AES","3 4 player arcade","Arcade Classics"

This only works on HyperLaunch v1.3 or RocketLauncher (v1.0 as of now). HyperSpin is now delivered with HyperLaunch v1.2, so you will need to update to use this MSystem update, on HyperLaunch 1.2, you will need to create a custom AHK, which is significantly more difficult, and if you want to use the latest versions, you will need to get them from RocketLauncher's Site.
Regarding the bill proposed by Sanders and others to raise minimum wage

Raising the minimum wage does not fix the problem, but it does help the symptom a bit.

The problem is the available disposable income in the lower X% of citizens.

The reason the middle class is vanishing and the reason families have to work 3-4 40 hour work weeks to make ends meet is because the cost of living is too high and the amount of disposable income is too low.

If you want to create jobs you currently don't have, you need to create a market for goods you currently aren't selling. If people don't have income they can afford to spend, they aren't going to buy new things. Our economy, for the lower X%, is slowly strangling itself because people just don't have money to spend of extra goods and services.

Sanders, rightly in my opinion, blames all the recovery and growth going to the top while the bottom is left to rot.

Increasing the min wage does not fix the problem, to fix it you have to somehow push the cost of living down and take money out of the hands of shareholders and put it in the hands of workers. (This IMO is the real crime. A worker does a good job, a company grows, all the benefits of labor goes to the investors. Paying the worker more for his hard work is an expense, its bad for the bottom line, the board does not like this, the investors do not like this, it is rejected as bad for the company. The worker slowly starves as he is over taken by inflation.)

Raising the minimum wage is a temporary life line, IMO. If we really want to fix things we have to re-evaluate how we do business in America. For skilled and unskilled labor. (such a dirty term, "unskilled", like because you aren't educated your job isn't hard and you deserve to be treated like human garbage)

The goal of the minimum wage is to outlaw low paying jobs for the unskilled and inexperienced. The law, simply, says: it is illegal, and therefore criminal, for anyone to hire anyone else below the level of X dollars an hour. This means, plainly and simply, that a large number of free and voluntary wage contracts are now outlawed and hence that there will be a large amount of unemployment. Remember that the minimum wage law provides no jobs; it only outlaws them; and outlawed jobs ( unemployment ) are the inevitable result.
